CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Password
CweFindings.Description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.
CweFindings.Explanation: A hard-coded default password constant is used to create seeded users in AppIdentityDbContextSeed, exposing static credential material.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
CweFindings.Description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: JWT signing key is hard-coded in AuthorizationConstants and consumed directly in PublicApi JWT configuration.

CweFindings.Name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CweFindings.Description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
CweFindings.Explanation: Authentication-related constants include hard-coded auth key, password, and JWT secret key credentials in source.
